# appmixer_user (Data Source)

Reads an existing Appmixer user by ID. Use this to reference a user that was created outside of Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appmixer_user" "ops" {
  user_id = "user-abc123"
}

output "ops_email" {
  value = data.appmixer_user.ops.email
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_id` (String) Server-assigned user ID to look up.

### Read-Only

- `email` (String) User's email address (login username).
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Arbitrary metadata attached to the user account.
- `scope` (List of String) Permission scopes assigned to the user.
